property_summary: For any actor and admissible amount, a non-reverting Collect must transfer exactly _am wei out of the contract: address(c).balance drops by exactly _am on success (and is unchanged on revert); the mutant never deducts the ledger/ETH pairing, so on the mutant a successful Collect leaves the caller's balance intact and the invariant of exact deduction is violated.
change_summary: Delete the statement that decrements balances[msg.sender] by _am, so collected funds are never deducted.
